source_decisions: Canonical 은들/을망정/을지언정 retain the full/attached coda allomorphs, ㄹ loss/retention and existing ㄷ/ㅅ/ㅂ/ㅎ irregular hypotheses. Bare verbs, adjectives, explicit copulas and 아니다 are supported.
NIKL 2026-05-11 Q&A 330951 explicitly specifies 있은들/없은들 and rejects the -는들 substitution. Do not import the ordinary existential adnominal paradigm here.

KRDict -ㄴ들/-은들 describes bare stems and honorific 시; 망정/지언정 additionally describe past 었. This implementation uses those finite prefinal licenses. Other past/modal proposals for 은들 are not declared globally ungrammatical; they require separate evidence.
KRDict -던들 specifies preceding 었 and provides counterfactual examples. Preserve it as a distinct ending following past (with optional honorific/double past), not as automatic 더+은들.

Particle ㄴ들/인들 and copula+은들 remain distinct readings at the same surface; adding endings removes no existing paths. Omitted copulas before these particular endings remain a separate attachment audit.

The new terminal endings can follow existing auxiliary chains; they do not create new auxiliary connector edges. Derivational 답다 retains its ㅂ-irregular boundary. Polite 요 is allowed, without treating the concession as a nominalization.
